overview: Doors with depth, doors that lock, doors that swing together, and six variants of every door and four of every trapdoor, for every material in the game.

1.0.4: Full means full: the full glass and full barred doors are cut the whole way down, so stacking two leaves no longer leaves a band of timber across the middle of the wall.
A lever opens a double gate as one gate. Both leaves answer a signal together, the way they already answered a hand.
1.0.3: Autoconnect can straighten a slid door's odd leaf. One leaf hung the wrong way used to break the whole wall, and nothing in the menu could put it right.
1.0.2: Doors built out of squares: mega doors, sliding walls, corner hinges, and an autoconnect button that joins the leaves for you.
Menus for gates and trapdoors, a trapdoor that re-hinges on any edge, solid doors that keep the light out, and the full glass and barred trapdoors moved to the stonecutter.
1.0.0: Doors that stand proud of the wall instead of lying flat in it, doors that lock, doors that swing together, and the same variants for every wood in the game.
